content: A lot of interop can be attained very inexpensively and quickly by hooking the input and output of each distinct network up to other networks that don't currently interop via inbound and outbound RSS. Neither ActivityPub or AT Proto are suited for that. Too complicated. RSS has has 20+ years of burn in. Lots of familiarity, and lots of working code. And WordPress is built around it and that is going to matter. When people get really serious about interop, and are willing to sacrifice a little personal glory, there's a very good compromise available.
